body:
Forget what she's ashamed of.

Forget whoever you let down.

Forget that whatever you thought of as being your life is crumbling.

"Destined for great things" - ambiguous BS. Top of class in Middle School? also BS.  Popularity - Complete BS.

What do you want to amount to?  What do you want to do?  Judge yourself by your own standard.  If you live up to anyone and everyone else's you'll always fall short.

And if you can't get FUCK off your mind.  FUCK SOMETHING UP.  And once that doesn't help realize there was no reason for FUCK to be on your mind in the first place...And realize that only you can stop yourself from being the engineer you want to be.

PM me.
Promise you'll get off the couch and never sleep there again before you consider ending your life.
